messages.text:
Hi Allie! Would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I think it'd be really nice to get a few of us together.

One favour: could you invite Jordan yourself, just as your own idea? Things have been a bit awkward between him and me lately, and I don't want him to feel it's about me. So please don't mention that I asked.

Let me know if Saturday works for you and I'll help with whatever you need.

Hi Sarah! Saturday works — 3:30 at my place sounds good. I'll take care of inviting Jordan; I'll bring it up myself so it doesn't trace back to you at all, don't worry.

I'll sort out snacks and drinks and let you know what's left to do. Thanks for thinking of it — it'll be nice to get everyone together.
Hey Jordan! I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday around 3:30 — nothing formal, just food and hanging out. Would be great if you came. Let me know?
Perfect, thank you! Saturday 3:30 at yours it is. I'll bring something for the table too — just tell me what you'd like me to cover.
Great. If you'd bring something sweet — a cake or cookies — that would cover the gap nicely. I'll handle the savoury stuff and drinks.
Sounds good — I'll bring a cake. See you Saturday!
Hey Allie! Sounds great — I'm in. I'll be there around 3:30 on Saturday. Thanks for the invite!
Great, see you Saturday at 3:30. No need to bring anything, but if you feel like it, something to drink is always welcome.
Perfect — I'll bring something to drink. See you Saturday at 3:30!
